description: This Java class 'TbRuleEngineProducerProvider' provides various message producer instances for different message types used within the Thingsboard rule engine, initializing them via a factory and exposing getter methods.

classes.name: TbRuleEngineProducerProvider
classes.description: A provider class that supplies various message producers for the rule engine, initialized after construction.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes all message producer instances after the object is constructed.

methods.name: getTransportNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for transport notification messages.

methods.name: getRuleEngineMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for rule engine messages.

methods.name: getRuleEngineNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for rule engine notification messages.

methods.name: getTbCoreMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for core messages.

methods.name: getTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for core notification messages.

methods.name: getTbEdgeMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for edge messages.

methods.name: getTbEdgeNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for edge notification messages.

methods.name: getTbEdgeEventsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for edge event notifications.

methods.name: getTbUsageStatsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for usage stats messages.

methods.name: getTbVersionControlMsgProducer
methods.description: Throws exception; not implemented, should not be used.

methods.name: getHousekeeperMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for housekeeper messages.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for calculated field messages.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldsNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for calculated field notification messages.
